;Disasters and accidents
*[[Crisis in Venezuela]]
**[[2019 Venezuelan blackout]]
***A nationwide [[Power outage|power blackout]] enters its second day in [[Venezuela]]. Information Minister [[Jorge Rodríguez (politician)|Jorge Rodríguez]] and [[Ministry of Defense (Venezuela)|Defense Minister]] [[Vladimir Padrino López]] claim the country appears to be the victim of a [[cyberattack]] intended to "derail the whole system". [[National Assembly (Venezuela)|Venezuelan National Assembly]]-declared Acting President [[Juan Guaidó]] stated that "state corruption and mismanagement (...) have left the electrical grid in shambles". [https://www.apnews.com/6ba2f69b77e2457da64593a7b8eced16 (AP)] [https://www.forbes.com/sites/kalevleetaru/2019/03/09/could-venezuelas-power-outage-really-be-a-cyber-attack/ (''Forbes'')]
*A truck overturns on a highway in [[Chiapas]], [[Mexico]], killing 25 [[Central America]]n migrants who were hiding inside. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-mexico-accident/truck-roll-over-in-mexico-kills-at-least-25-idUSKCN1QP0I1 (Reuters)]
;Law and crime
*[[Shoreham Airshow crash]]
**Pilot Andy Hill is acquitted of eleven counts of manslaughter arising from the 2015 accident, in which a jet flown by Hill struck a road in [[Shoreham-by-Sea|Shoreham]], [[England]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2019/mar/08/shoreham-airshow-crash-pilot-andrew-hill-cleared-over-deaths-of-11-people (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Chelsea Manning]] is jailed for refusing to answer questions from a federal grand jury in [[Virginia]] looking into the release of documents to [[WikiLeaks]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/chelsea-manning-jailed-refusing-testify-grand-jury-virginia-n980016 (NBC News)]
*Actor [[Jussie Smollett]] is indicted on 16 felony counts of disorderly conduct for allegedly filing a false [[hate crime]] police report in January in Chicago. [https://www.yahoo.com/gma/empire-actor-jussie-smollett-hit-16-count-felony-221107076--abc-news-topstories.html (Yahoo! News)]

; Politics and elections
*[[Politics of Finland]]
**The entire coalition government of [[Finland]] resigns after a failure to deliver on [[Healthcare in Finland|healthcare]] reform, a month ahead of the [[2019 Finnish parliamentary election|country's general election]]. The coalition, made up of Prime Minister [[Juha Sipilä]]'s [[Centre Party (Finland)|Centre Party]], the conservative [[National Coalition Party]] and the [[Euroscepticism|Eurosceptic]] [[Blue Reform|Blue Reform Party]], were unable to agree on a package that would have slowed healthcare spending over the next decade. The government will be ''interim'' until April elections. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-finland-government/finlands-cabinet-quits-over-failure-to-deliver-healthcare-reform-idUSKCN1QP0R6 (Reuters)]
